mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad economic slowdown, triggering a bearish market reaction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both PAYEMS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized rate > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, which pressures equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized rate > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,300 thousand units, it signals strong economic demand and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a contraction in the real economy, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high consumer credit growth (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars), the economy faces credit risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
